fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Mechanized hover platoons ride hovercraft that provide the fastest ground transport available to conventional infantry, capable of crossing water obstacles and covering open terrain at speeds that allow them to screen for heavier formations or exploit gaps in enemy lines. Supplementing their rifles with portable machine guns that provide sustained automatic fire, these platoons anchor defensive positions with suppressive capability that pins attacking infantry and discourages unarmored vehicles from closing.
